sub_cap_revisions.detail: The first frozen merge configuration (thinking enabled, no json_object, max_tokens 16384) spent its entire output budget on reasoning tokens: 10/10 merge cells failed as technical failures (A_rep1 truncated mid-JSON with 15627 reasoning tokens; B/C/Df/Dp rep1 returned empty content twice each). $0.2894 of the first sub-cap was consumed by those 9 unusable calls. Main-session decision recorded in F:/defense/LOG.md, re-frozen as RW-b: merge calls only are changed to thinking disabled + json_object + max_tokens 8192, prose moved inside the JSON as answer_prose. Baseline unchanged; extraction results and all prior call logs kept.

sub_cap_revisions.reason: RW-c confirmation + policy arm per PREREG_rw_c.md
sub_cap_revisions.detail: RW-b spent $0.5447 of the $0.65 sub-cap. RW-c adds a confirmation arm (C x6, Dp x6, reps 3-8, frozen RW-b merge configuration, pooled with RW-b's 2 each to 8/8) and a policy arm (C-policy x4, Dp-policy x4, --policy flag). Per-exp_key call cap also raised 80 -> 100. Baseline unchanged; RW-b outputs are not overwritten because policy cells are named <cond>P_rep<N>.

note: baseline is the evidence-package-pilot line total at the first paid rw call and is never revised; the guard cap is min(line_cap, baseline + current sub_cap).
